profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Accolade
profile.summary:
An introspective engineer focused on improving inefficient/inappropriate processes, I always strive to make the people around me better at their jobs. I'm excited by opportunities to help scale out engineering teams and build the essential infrastructure for large-scale data processing. My interests include distributed systems, big data architectures, statistical inference, and all things quantitative. I like to push the boundaries of what is possible.

A self-taught CS theory geek who's happy discussing type theory and paradigms of functional programming, and jumps at the chance to do a literature review. A pragmatic developer who tends toward the tried and true over the experimental, and would rather ship more features then spend time polishing one small piece.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Leading the effort to transition how we track and process medical election data, governing who is eligible for our service and how we bill our customers. Building a configurable, scalable, and extensible data ingestion HIPAA-compliant ETL system, to enable onboarding more new customers, faster. AWS, Spark, Python, SQL.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Founding senior engineer on the Core/Platform team. We maintain all sources of location and user data, collaborate closely with data scientists to produce visitation data from various sources of raw GPS observations, and maintain developer tools and environments. Technologies include Ruby, Java, Python, Hadoop and Spark on Amazon AWS/EMR/S3, Mongo, Jenkins.

Led the introduction of international demographic models, involving extensive code archeology of cross-system data dependencies; documenting and presenting on how demographics flow from users through to reports; refactoring to enable multiple countries; and adding the first three additional countries
Reduced latency of a critical-path pipeline from 17 hours to 6 hours by proposing and implementing a new scheduling architecture
Productionalized and integrated a prototype from a data scientist that cut 6 hours from our core visitation-prediction pipeline
Proposed improvements to reliability that cut pager incidents in half across the entire engineering org
Suggested debugging improvements to automate access to root causes, eliminating 4-5 rote actions while searching for logs
Simplified the development process by eliminating the need for an error-prone configuration file necessary for running development code at scale
Co-founded a technical book club, currently on our fourth book

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Founding member of our Science Engineering team, focused on innovations in the core mathematical and data-driven components of our products. Worked closely with data scientists to get the right data in the right place feeding the right algorithms in as many cases as possible. 

Technical owner of our A/B testing framework, leading a major refactoring that focused on improving the statistical sophistication and reporting capabilities. Technologies used include Java, Hadoop/HDFS/YARN, HBase, Hive, Kafka, Hibernate, Postgres/SQL.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As part of a team of four, built  a system in six weeks to predict hospital readmission rates for patients at time of discharge, which was presented at HIMSS13. My responsibilities included data ingestion, feature engineering, and statistical analysis of terabyte-sized structured medical data in Hive, Python, and Hadoop.

Designed and implemented a system in Python to extract status updates from Twitter and Facebook, queue in a SQL database, and load into our proprietary analytics platform.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test
positions.description: Wrote test automation for Windows 7 and Windows 8, for XPS Viewer and UI elements in the "modern shell". Spearheaded accessibility efforts across a 35-member test group.
